analyst_view.overall: Schalke (17th, 6 points, one win in nine) host Stuttgart (8th, 12 points, two league wins in a row) at 18:30; Schalke have scored only five league goals and none in four home games, though they have conceded just 11. Miron Muslic gets striker Moussa Sylla and Gantenbein back in full training (Bulinews), while top scorer Robin Gosens returned to partial training after his knee knock and a decision on him was due Friday (Flashscore); Becker and Woeber are out and counted. Stuttgart are without midfield organiser Angelo Stiller (Stuttgarter Zeitung, 19 Nov) and Jaquez, both counted for goals, with Demirovic (five goals) leading the line. Sebastian Hoeness wants high intensity; Daniel Siebert referees, and his slightly higher card record is already added.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.1 goals and already take off for Woeber at Schalke and Stiller and Vagnoman at Stuttgart. What they can't see is that Gosens, Schalke's top scorer, is at best short of full fitness for a side without a home goal in four games, with Sylla only just back in training, so I trim 3%, to about 2.0.

corners.text: The numbers say 10.5 corners, with Stuttgart expected to win about 6 of them. Schalke defend deep and counter, which hands visitors corners, and Stuttgart's wing-backs push play wide, but both habits are already in the teams' records, so I stay at 10.5.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.6 cards and already add about 8% for referee Daniel Siebert (4.1 a game) plus a little for Schalke's recent games. A physical Schalke in front of a full house is how they play every home game and it is in their record, so I stay at 3.6.

shots.text: The numbers say 27.9 shots. Schalke's attack produces few shots and may lack a fully fit Gosens, and Stuttgart still miss their main midfield passer Stiller; the numbers count Stiller only for goals, not shot volume, so I trim 2%, to about 27.3.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.6 shots on target and already cut Schalke's for their poor recent accuracy (13 on target in six). Gosens doubtful and Stiller out make both build-ups a bit poorer, and Sylla is only a bench option after weeks out, so I trim 3%, to about 9.3.
